card.name: Inside words ending in -ggle or -gle
card.fires_on: The middle or end piece of a word split partway, especially the 'gle' or 'gg' in words like wriggle, wiggling, Eggleston, Muggle. Also the 'gle' that begins glecaprevir after a period.
